unlistedSourceDisposition.summary: All nine source routes predate the sweep. The slate explicitly excludes eight, including six previously removed records. The remaining route is the desktop tear-out proof. Zero new or uncertain catalog promises were found among the nine. Two separately tracked Functional Components tiles are promised and still absent at cutoff.
unlistedSourceDisposition.test: For all eleven exact roots, index.html has the same Git blob at baseline and cutoff. The four launch-mode URLs and sourceUrl were compared against each exact root in the split catalog. Related records are shown only on their own distinct routes.

workbenchAuthority.scope: The 37 conversions preserve example behavior and expose authored config to the Workbench. #22068 specifies no catalog-record additions.

nineReviewedRoutes.disposition: The slate uses button-base to show the ripple option and excludes a second effect-only tile.
The bare canvas workbench intentionally draws nothing. The Charts decision removed its record and retained its source for existing callers.
This is one of the four MWC wrappers removed from More components. The Workbench conversion updates the retained source.
The four-wrapper MWC retirement explicitly includes the text field. The Workbench conversion updates the retained source.
The slate explicitly retires the standalone German trip form while retaining the generic Process tile. The two examples have separate launch paths. The old process-real-world ID was removed.
The slate retires the internal date-picker subcomponent. The remaining date-selector tile opens examples/component/dateSelector.

The desktop basic example exercises the held drag, popup, return and refusal paths. #21603 names this exact proof entry. The Apps slate assigns the public src/desktop card to Web Desktop at apps/webdesktop.
The slate retires the bare Picker base used by the concrete fields. The former picker-field record was removed. The Range entry named in the Forms row is present.
The slate excludes the panel as a twin of Menu List. The retained menu-list tile launches a separate example.

functionalPublication.stateAtCutoff: The two renewed sources were merged. #21932 expressly calls for two tiles and their crops. Engine #22056 was open in draft. Its two records cover all four modes. All four JPEGs existed on the staged Pages commit and were absent from cutoff Pages main.
